## What is affected?

- [ ] AFI specification text
- [ ] Reference SDK / library
- [ ] Conformance test kit
- [ ] Documentation site
- [ ] Other (describe below)

## Describe the bug

A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## Where in the spec / code?

Link to the affected page or file:

- Spec page: <!-- e.g., https://ucalyptus.github.io/afi/specification/draft/operations/read/ -->
- File / line: <!-- e.g., docs/specification/draft/operations/read.md#L45 -->

## Expected behavior

What did you expect to happen, and why?

## Actual behavior

What actually happens? For spec bugs, describe the ambiguity or
contradiction. For code bugs, include full error output.

## Steps to reproduce

For code bugs only — include a minimal reproduction:

```
1.
2.
3.
```

## Environment

- AFI spec version: <!-- draft, 0.1, ... -->
- Provider / implementation: <!-- e.g., AgentFS 0.4, custom D1 -->
- Transport binding: <!-- MCP / HTTP / FUSE / SSH -->

## Additional context

Anything else that would help us reproduce or understand the bug.
